FromFiles.summary: Attempts to add the clips from the given files to the cache with keys based on files' names. Do not use this for storing lengthy audio, stream the files instead.

NoTime.remarks: If an entry already exists, it will be overwritten. Audio is automatically converted to player-compatible samples.

Time.remarks: If an entry already exists, it will be overwritten. Audio is automatically converted to player-compatible samples. Audio file duration may be an estimate for compressed files.
